pairs.en: USAR teams of the DACHL network (Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Luxembourg) regularly facilitate trainings for different USAR areas and invite international colleagues to participate.
pairs.zh: DACHL网络（德国、奥地利、瑞士、卢森堡）的USAR救援队定期为不同USAR领域举办培训，并邀请国际同行参加。
pairs.title_en: ToT UC Course Sep25 in Ulm: Empowering Trainers for Effective USAR Coordination
pairs.title_zh: 2025年9月乌尔姆ToT UC课程：赋能培训师，提升USAR协调效能

pairs.en: This year, the German Federal Agency for Technical Relief (THW) hosted an INSARAG Training of Trainers for USAR Coordination Courses (ToT UC Course) at THW’s Logistic Centre in Ulm, Germany from 31st August to 6th September 2025.
pairs.zh: 今年，德国联邦技术救援署（THW）于2025年8月31日至9月6日在德国乌尔姆的THW后勤中心主办了INSARAG USAR协调课程培训师培训（ToT UC课程）。
pairs.title_en: ToT UC Course Sep25 in Ulm: Empowering Trainers for Effective USAR Coordination
pairs.title_zh: 2025年9月乌尔姆ToT UC课程：赋能培训师，提升USAR协调效能

pairs.en: 17 participants from different countries of the AEME region took part in the five-day course.
pairs.zh: 来自AEME地区不同国家的17名学员参加了为期五天的课程。
pairs.title_en: ToT UC Course Sep25 in Ulm: Empowering Trainers for Effective USAR Coordination
pairs.title_zh: 2025年9月乌尔姆ToT UC课程：赋能培训师，提升USAR协调效能

pairs.en: The content was structured in three days of theoretical input and two days for the practical earthquake simulation.
pairs.zh: 课程内容安排为三天理论授课和两天地震模拟实操。
pairs.title_en: ToT UC Course Sep25 in Ulm: Empowering Trainers for Effective USAR Coordination
pairs.title_zh: 2025年9月乌尔姆ToT UC课程：赋能培训师，提升USAR协调效能

pairs.en: Additionally, a guided tour through the Logistic Centre and a visit to the local branch of Neu-Ulm gave insights into THW’s national capacities.
pairs.zh: 此外，参观后勤中心以及走访新乌尔姆当地分支机构，使学员深入了解了THW的国家能力。
pairs.title_en: ToT UC Course Sep25 in Ulm: Empowering Trainers for Effective USAR Coordination
pairs.title_zh: 2025年9月乌尔姆ToT UC课程：赋能培训师，提升USAR协调效能

pairs.en: During the first two days, five experienced INSARAG trainers provided theoretical input according to the ToT UC Course training package: basics of instructing, communication skills, adult learning, and creating a positive learning environment.
pairs.zh: 在前两天，五位经验丰富的INSARAG培训师按照ToT UC课程培训包提供了理论授课：授课基础、沟通技巧、成人学习以及营造积极的学习环境。
pairs.title_en: ToT UC Course Sep25 in Ulm: Empowering Trainers for Effective USAR Coordination
pairs.title_zh: 2025年9月乌尔姆ToT UC课程：赋能培训师，提升USAR协调效能

pairs.en: Furthermore, they covered information about GDACS, VOSOCC and ICMS.
pairs.zh: 此外，他们还介绍了GDACS、VOSOCC和ICMS的相关信息。
pairs.title_en: ToT UC Course Sep25 in Ulm: Empowering Trainers for Effective USAR Coordination
pairs.title_zh: 2025年9月乌尔姆ToT UC课程：赋能培训师，提升USAR协调效能

pairs.en: On the third day, participants gave presentations, in which they were able to apply their presentation and communication skills.
pairs.zh: 第三天，学员进行了演示汇报，得以运用自己的表达和沟通技巧。
pairs.title_en: ToT UC Course Sep25 in Ulm: Empowering Trainers for Effective USAR Coordination
pairs.title_zh: 2025年9月乌尔姆ToT UC课程：赋能培训师，提升USAR协调效能

pairs.en: Throughout these days, methods and creative activities were included, that participants can use as an inspiration for their own future UC courses.
pairs.zh: 在这些天里，课程还融入了多种方法和创意活动，学员可将其作为今后自己开展UC课程的灵感。
pairs.title_en: ToT UC Course Sep25 in Ulm: Empowering Trainers for Effective USAR Coordination
pairs.title_zh: 2025年9月乌尔姆ToT UC课程：赋能培训师，提升USAR协调效能

pairs.en: In the morning of the fourth day an additional media training was integrated, facilitated by THW media experts.
pairs.zh: 第四天上午，还增设了一场媒体培训，由THW媒体专家主持。
pairs.title_en: ToT UC Course Sep25 in Ulm: Empowering Trainers for Effective USAR Coordination
pairs.title_zh: 2025年9月乌尔姆ToT UC课程：赋能培训师，提升USAR协调效能

pairs.en: Participants received theoretical instructions on how to effectively manage media interactions and engage with reporters during a deployment.
pairs.zh: 学员接受了关于如何在部署期间有效管理媒体互动和应对记者的理论指导。
pairs.title_en: ToT UC Course Sep25 in Ulm: Empowering Trainers for Effective USAR Coordination
pairs.title_zh: 2025年9月乌尔姆ToT UC课程：赋能培训师，提升USAR协调效能

pairs.en: Afterwards, the participants had the opportunity to put their knowledge into practice: The course proceeded with a practical UCC simulation of an earthquake in so called Etruria.
pairs.zh: 随后，学员有机会将所学知识付诸实践：课程接着进行了所谓“埃特鲁里亚”地震的UCC模拟实操。
pairs.title_en: ToT UC Course Sep25 in Ulm: Empowering Trainers for Effective USAR Coordination
pairs.title_zh: 2025年9月乌尔姆ToT UC课程：赋能培训师，提升USAR协调效能

pairs.en: Divided into two groups, one group acted as EXCON, while the other group took part in the simulation itself.
pairs.zh: 学员分为两组，一组担任EXCON，另一组参加模拟本身。
pairs.title_en: ToT UC Course Sep25 in Ulm: Empowering Trainers for Effective USAR Coordination
pairs.title_zh: 2025年9月乌尔姆ToT UC课程：赋能培训师，提升USAR协调效能

pairs.en: The next morning, the groups’ tasks were switched.
pairs.zh: 第二天上午，两组任务互换。
pairs.title_en: ToT UC Course Sep25 in Ulm: Empowering Trainers for Effective USAR Coordination
pairs.title_zh: 2025年9月乌尔姆ToT UC课程：赋能培训师，提升USAR协调效能

pairs.en: Within the exercise, participants were confronted with simulated media teams asking for information and an UNDAC-trained THW volunteer, providing opportunities for cooperation of different UN coordination components.
pairs.zh: 演练中，学员面对索要信息的模拟媒体团队，以及一名受过UNDAC培训的THW志愿者，为不同联合国协调部门的合作提供了机会。
pairs.title_en: ToT UC Course Sep25 in Ulm: Empowering Trainers for Effective USAR Coordination
pairs.title_zh: 2025年9月乌尔姆ToT UC课程：赋能培训师，提升USAR协调效能

pairs.en: This setup allowed all participants to practice effective exercise management in a realistic scenario.
pairs.zh: 这一安排使所有学员都能在逼真的场景中练习有效的演练管理。
pairs.title_en: ToT UC Course Sep25 in Ulm: Empowering Trainers for Effective USAR Coordination
pairs.title_zh: 2025年9月乌尔姆ToT UC课程：赋能培训师，提升USAR协调效能

pairs.en: The ToT UC course equipped its participants with valuable skills and comprehensive knowledge focused on training other trainers.
pairs.zh: ToT UC课程为学员提供了宝贵的技能和全面的知识，重点在于培训其他培训师。
pairs.title_en: ToT UC Course Sep25 in Ulm: Empowering Trainers for Effective USAR Coordination
pairs.title_zh: 2025年9月乌尔姆ToT UC课程：赋能培训师，提升USAR协调效能

pairs.en: By empowering trainers with this expertise, the program ensures a sustainable and multiplying effect – enabling trained instructors to effectively pass on their knowledge and methodologies to future UC courses.
pairs.zh: 通过赋予培训师这一专长，该项目确保了可持续的倍增效应——使受训讲师能够有效地将知识和教学方法传授给未来的UC课程。
pairs.title_en: ToT UC Course Sep25 in Ulm: Empowering Trainers for Effective USAR Coordination
pairs.title_zh: 2025年9月乌尔姆ToT UC课程：赋能培训师，提升USAR协调效能

pairs.en: It strengthens the overall capacity and readiness of USAR Coordination, supporting INSARAG’s mission to save lives through efficient, well-coordinated USAR deployments worldwide.
pairs.zh: 它增强了USAR协调的整体能力和准备水平，支持INSARAG通过在全球范围内高效、协调良好的USAR部署来拯救生命的使命。
pairs.title_en: ToT UC Course Sep25 in Ulm: Empowering Trainers for Effective USAR Coordination
pairs.title_zh: 2025年9月乌尔姆ToT UC课程：赋能培训师，提升USAR协调效能

pairs.en: By: Charlie Kuletzki and Daniela Glatz
pairs.zh: 作者：Charlie Kuletzki 和 Daniela Glatz
pairs.title_en: ToT UC Course Sep25 in Ulm: Empowering Trainers for Effective USAR Coordination
pairs.title_zh: 2025年9月乌尔姆ToT UC课程：赋能培训师，提升USAR协调效能

pairs.en: The INSARAG Community Responder Training (CRT) was developed to provide guidance and training for first aiders on community level.
pairs.zh: INSARAG 社区响应者培训（CRT）旨在为社区层面的急救人员提供指导和培训。
pairs.title_en: INSARAG Community Responder Training: Enhancing Civil Society Preparedness in the Kurdistan Region Iraq
pairs.title_zh: INSARAG 社区响应者培训：提升伊拉克库尔德地区民间社会备灾能力

pairs.en: Analysis of earthquakes have shown that the majority of successful rescues are done within the first hours by civilians – neighbors and family members – long before professional help can arrive.
pairs.zh: 对地震的分析表明，大多数成功的救援是在最初几小时内由平民——邻居和家人——完成的，远早于专业救援力量能够到达。
pairs.title_en: INSARAG Community Responder Training: Enhancing Civil Society Preparedness in the Kurdistan Region Iraq
pairs.title_zh: INSARAG 社区响应者培训：提升伊拉克库尔德地区民间社会备灾能力

pairs.en: Thus, the CRT aims to build and develop local capacities within civil society to respond to incidents in areas where no organized USAR teams are (yet) present.
pairs.zh: 因此，CRT 旨在建立并发展民间社会的地方能力，以便在（尚）没有有组织的 USAR 救援队的地区应对突发事件。
pairs.title_en: INSARAG Community Responder Training: Enhancing Civil Society Preparedness in the Kurdistan Region Iraq
pairs.title_zh: INSARAG 社区响应者培训：提升伊拉克库尔德地区民间社会备灾能力

pairs.en: In 2023 the ISG endorsed the Community Responder Training Package (back then under the name “First Responder Training 2.0”).
pairs.zh: 2023 年，ISG 批准了社区响应者培训包（当时名称为“急救人员培训 2.0”）。
pairs.title_en: INSARAG Community Responder Training: Enhancing Civil Society Preparedness in the Kurdistan Region Iraq
pairs.title_zh: INSARAG 社区响应者培训：提升伊拉克库尔德地区民间社会备灾能力

pairs.en: The training covers the complete theoretical and practical standard curriculum of the INSARAG, focusing on disaster assessment and information gathering, formation of responder teams, task allocation within the teams, simple search and rescue operations, basic medical care, and reporting.
pairs.zh: 该培训涵盖 INSARAG 完整的理论和实践标准课程，重点包括灾害评估与信息收集、响应者队伍的组建、队伍内部的任务分配、简易搜索与救援行动、基础医疗救护以及报告。
pairs.title_en: INSARAG Community Responder Training: Enhancing Civil Society Preparedness in the Kurdistan Region Iraq
pairs.title_zh: INSARAG 社区响应者培训：提升伊拉克库尔德地区民间社会备灾能力

pairs.en: The Kurdistan Region of Iraq was one of five countries that has implemented the INSARAG Community Responder Training.
pairs.zh: 伊拉克库尔德地区是实施 INSARAG 社区响应者培训的五个国家之一。
pairs.title_en: INSARAG Community Responder Training: Enhancing Civil Society Preparedness in the Kurdistan Region Iraq
pairs.title_zh: INSARAG 社区响应者培训：提升伊拉克库尔德地区民间社会备灾能力

pairs.en: An essential success factor is the careful localization of the training.
pairs.zh: 一个关键的成功因素是培训的精心本地化。
pairs.title_en: INSARAG Community Responder Training: Enhancing Civil Society Preparedness in the Kurdistan Region Iraq
pairs.title_zh: INSARAG 社区响应者培训：提升伊拉克库尔德地区民间社会备灾能力

pairs.en: Local trainers adapt the standardized content to the community-specific conditions—whether it is the local earthquake risk, typical types of disasters, regional building styles, or real examples from the area.
pairs.zh: 本地培训师将标准化内容调整为适应社区具体情况——无论是当地的地震风险、典型的灾害类型、区域建筑风格，还是该地区的真实案例。
pairs.title_en: INSARAG Community Responder Training: Enhancing Civil Society Preparedness in the Kurdistan Region Iraq
pairs.title_zh: INSARAG 社区响应者培训：提升伊拉克库尔德地区民间社会备灾能力

pairs.en: This practical approach ensures that participants better understand the content and can directly apply the exercises in their daily lives.
pairs.zh: 这种实践性方法确保参与者更好地理解内容，并能在日常生活中直接应用所学演练。
pairs.title_en: INSARAG Community Responder Training: Enhancing Civil Society Preparedness in the Kurdistan Region Iraq
pairs.title_zh: INSARAG 社区响应者培训：提升伊拉克库尔德地区民间社会备灾能力

pairs.en: From October 13 to 16, 2025, the Joint Crisis Coordination Center (JCC) held the Community Responder Training Week for the second time in the Kurdistan Region of Iraq with the support by the German Agency for Technical Relief (THW).
pairs.zh: 2025 年 10 月 13 日至 16 日，联合危机协调中心（JCC）在德国联邦技术救援署（THW）的支持下，第二次在伊拉克库尔德地区举办社区响应者培训周。
pairs.title_en: INSARAG Community Responder Training: Enhancing Civil Society Preparedness in the Kurdistan Region Iraq
pairs.title_zh: INSARAG 社区响应者培训：提升伊拉克库尔德地区民间社会备灾能力

pairs.en: During this event, five CRT courses took place simultaneously across the entire Kurdistan Region of Iraq.
pairs.zh: 在此期间，五期 CRT 课程在伊拉克库尔德地区各地同时举行。
pairs.title_en: INSARAG Community Responder Training: Enhancing Civil Society Preparedness in the Kurdistan Region Iraq
pairs.title_zh: INSARAG 社区响应者培训：提升伊拉克库尔德地区民间社会备灾能力

pairs.en: A total of 125 participants from civil society, including teachers, volunteers, and agency staff, were trained in Erbil, Sulaymaniah, Halabja, Dohuk, and Raparin.
pairs.zh: 共有 125 名来自民间社会的参与者，包括教师、志愿者和机构工作人员，在埃尔比勒、苏莱曼尼亚、哈拉卜贾、杜胡克和拉帕林接受了培训。
pairs.title_en: INSARAG Community Responder Training: Enhancing Civil Society Preparedness in the Kurdistan Region Iraq
pairs.title_zh: INSARAG 社区响应者培训：提升伊拉克库尔德地区民间社会备灾能力

pairs.en: Already in November 2024, the training was conducted simultaneously at five locations in the region.
pairs.zh: 早在 2024 年 11 月，该培训就已在该地区的五个地点同时开展。
pairs.title_en: INSARAG Community Responder Training: Enhancing Civil Society Preparedness in the Kurdistan Region Iraq
pairs.title_zh: INSARAG 社区响应者培训：提升伊拉克库尔德地区民间社会备灾能力

pairs.en: The training is fully organized and conducted by JCC.
pairs.zh: 该培训完全由 JCC 组织和实施。
pairs.title_en: INSARAG Community Responder Training: Enhancing Civil Society Preparedness in the Kurdistan Region Iraq
pairs.title_zh: INSARAG 社区响应者培训：提升伊拉克库尔德地区民间社会备灾能力

pairs.en: THW provides administrative support and, together with a representative from the German Federal Ministry of the Interior, officially launched the event digitally.
pairs.zh: THW 提供行政支持，并与德国联邦内政部的一名代表一起以线上方式正式启动了该活动。
pairs.title_en: INSARAG Community Responder Training: Enhancing Civil Society Preparedness in the Kurdistan Region Iraq
pairs.title_zh: INSARAG 社区响应者培训：提升伊拉克库尔德地区民间社会备灾能力

pairs.en: The training was mainly conducted by JCC master trainers supported by THW staff, who took part in the test-run of the CRT by THW in 2023 in Wesel, Germany.
pairs.zh: 培训主要由 JCC 的培训师主讲，并由 THW 工作人员协助，这些工作人员曾参加 2023 年在德国韦塞尔举行的 THW CRT 试运行。
pairs.title_en: INSARAG Community Responder Training: Enhancing Civil Society Preparedness in the Kurdistan Region Iraq
pairs.title_zh: INSARAG 社区响应者培训：提升伊拉克库尔德地区民间社会备灾能力

pairs.en: JCC has proven outstanding commitment furthering the trainings.
pairs.zh: JCC 在推进培训方面展现了卓越的投入。
pairs.title_en: INSARAG Community Responder Training: Enhancing Civil Society Preparedness in the Kurdistan Region Iraq
pairs.title_zh: INSARAG 社区响应者培训：提升伊拉克库尔德地区民间社会备灾能力

pairs.en: Looking back, THW supported JCC conducting 43 Community Responder Trainings in the Kurdistan Region of Iraq.
pairs.zh: 回顾过去，THW 支持 JCC 在伊拉克库尔德地区开展了 43 期社区响应者培训。
pairs.title_en: INSARAG Community Responder Training: Enhancing Civil Society Preparedness in the Kurdistan Region Iraq
pairs.title_zh: INSARAG 社区响应者培训：提升伊拉克库尔德地区民间社会备灾能力

pairs.en: Up to today, around 1.000 Community Responders have been trained.
pairs.zh: 迄今为止，已有约 1,000 名社区响应者接受了培训。
pairs.title_en: INSARAG Community Responder Training: Enhancing Civil Society Preparedness in the Kurdistan Region Iraq
pairs.title_zh: INSARAG 社区响应者培训：提升伊拉克库尔德地区民间社会备灾能力

pairs.en: The Community Responder Training is a significant step toward better preparing the local population for potential crises, especially earthquakes.
pairs.zh: 社区响应者培训是帮助当地民众更好地为潜在危机、尤其是地震做好准备的重要一步。
pairs.title_en: INSARAG Community Responder Training: Enhancing Civil Society Preparedness in the Kurdistan Region Iraq

pairs.en: It is crucial for the protection and safety – not only of the communities in the Kurdistan Region Iraq.
pairs.zh: 这对保护和安全至关重要——不仅对伊拉克库尔德地区的社区而言。

pairs.en: INSARAG congratulates China, the 10 countries in the world on the successful completion and endorsement of its INSARAG Recognized National Accreditation Process (IRNAP).
pairs.zh: INSARAG 祝贺中国——全球第 10 个成功完成并获批其 INSARAG 认可国家认证程序（IRNAP）的国家。
pairs.title_en: IRNAP China
pairs.title_zh: IRNAP 中国

pairs.en: This achievement highlights China’s strong commitment to INSARAG’s global standards and continuous efforts to enhance international cooperation and preparedness in Urban Search and Rescue (USAR) operations.
pairs.zh: 这一成就彰显了中国对 INSARAG 全球标准的坚定承诺，以及在城市搜索与救援（USAR）行动中不断加强国际合作与备灾能力的不懈努力。
pairs.title_en: IRNAP China
pairs.title_zh: IRNAP 中国

pairs.en: The INSARAG Secretariat commends the dedication and professionalism demonstrated throughout the process and looks forward to continued collaboration within our global network.
pairs.zh: INSARAG 秘书处赞扬整个过程中展现出的奉献精神与专业素养，并期待在我们全球网络内继续开展合作。
pairs.title_en: IRNAP China
pairs.title_zh: IRNAP 中国

pairs.en: From 23 to 27 March 2026, the National Fire Agency (NFA) of the Republic of Korea, in collaboration with the Korea Disaster Relief Team (KDRT), hosted the Urban Search and Rescue Coordination Cell (UCC) Course in Busan, Republic of Korea.
pairs.zh: 2026年3月23日至27日，大韩民国国家消防厅（NFA）与韩国灾难救援队（KDRT）合作，在大韩民国釜山主办了城市搜索与救援协调小组（UCC）课程。
pairs.title_en: Asia-Pacific USAR Team Coordination Course in the Republic of Korea, 23-27 March 2026
pairs.title_zh: 2026年3月23日至27日在大韩民国举办的亚太地区USAR救援队协调课程

pairs.en: The course brought together 22 participants from eight international Urban Search and Rescue (USAR) teams, engaged in practical exercises and knowledge exchange, contributing to a more cohesive and capable global USAR network.
pairs.zh: 该课程汇集了来自八支国际城市搜索与救援（USAR）救援队的22名参与者，开展了实操演练和知识交流，为构建更加紧密、更有能力的全球USAR网络作出了贡献。
pairs.title_en: Asia-Pacific USAR Team Coordination Course in the Republic of Korea, 23-27 March 2026
pairs.title_zh: 2026年3月23日至27日在大韩民国举办的亚太地区USAR救援队协调课程

pairs.en: The training reinforced regional cooperation and advanced a shared commitment to effective, coordinated disaster response.
pairs.zh: 此次培训加强了区域合作，并推进了对有效、协调的灾害响应的共同承诺。
pairs.title_en: Asia-Pacific USAR Team Coordination Course in the Republic of Korea, 23-27 March 2026
pairs.title_zh: 2026年3月23日至27日在大韩民国举办的亚太地区USAR救援队协调课程

pairs.en: Delivered under the guidance of expert instructors from the International Search and Rescue Advisory Group (INSARAG), the training focused on strengthening coordination capacities in line with INSARAG methodology, promoting interoperability, and enhancing readiness for complex emergency operations.
pairs.zh: 该培训在国际搜索与救援咨询团（INSARAG）专家教员的指导下开展，重点在于按照INSARAG方法加强协调能力、促进互操作性，并提升应对复杂紧急行动的准备水平。
pairs.title_en: Asia-Pacific USAR Team Coordination Course in the Republic of Korea, 23-27 March 2026
pairs.title_zh: 2026年3月23日至27日在大韩民国举办的亚太地区USAR救援队协调课程

pairs.en: The successful completion of the course by all participants reflects the continued dedication of USAR teams to uphold INSARAG standards and further improve collective response capabilities.
pairs.zh: 全体参与者顺利完成为该课程，体现了USAR救援队对维护INSARAG标准、进一步提升集体响应能力的持续奉献。
pairs.title_en: Asia-Pacific USAR Team Coordination Course in the Republic of Korea, 23-27 March 2026
pairs.title_zh: 2026年3月23日至27日在大韩民国举办的亚太地区USAR救援队协调课程

pairs.en: This training course underscores the importance of international collaboration in ensuring timely, efficient, and life-saving assistance in disaster-affected areas.
pairs.zh: 此次培训课程凸显了国际合作在确保向受灾地区提供及时、高效、挽救生命的援助方面的重要性。
pairs.title_en: Asia-Pacific USAR Team Coordination Course in the Republic of Korea, 23-27 March 2026
pairs.title_zh: 2026年3月23日至27日在大韩民国举办的亚太地区USAR救援队协调课程

pairs.en: Appreciation is extended to the NFA and the KDRT for hosting the course, and to the expert instructors from Australia, Singapore, and the Republic of Korea for their invaluable contributions.
pairs.zh: 谨向主办该课程的国家消防厅（NFA）和韩国灾难救援队（KDRT）表示感谢，并向来自澳大利亚、新加坡和大韩民国的专家教员所作出的宝贵贡献表示感谢。
pairs.title_en: Asia-Pacific USAR Team Coordination Course in the Republic of Korea, 23-27 March 2026
pairs.title_zh: 2026年3月23日至27日在大韩民国举办的亚太地区USAR救援队协调课程

pairs.en: On 2 June 2026 an Exercise Hosting Coordination Framework between Lekhwiya and INSARAG was signed in preparation for the INSARAG Global Exercise (Qatar, 25 to 29 October 2026).
pairs.zh: 2026年6月2日，为筹备INSARAG全球演练（卡塔尔，2026年10月25日至29日），Lekhwiya与INSARAG签署了演练主办协调框架。
pairs.title_en: Exercise Hosting Coordination Framework in Qatar
pairs.title_zh: 卡塔尔演练主办协调框架

pairs.en: The arrangement was signed by Ambassador Dominik Stillhart, INSARAG Global Chair, and Staff Brigadier Mubarak Sherida Al Kaabi, Assistant Commander for Administration and Supply.
pairs.zh: 该安排由INSARAG全球主席Dominik Stillhart大使与负责行政与供应的助理指挥官Mubarak Sherida Al Kaabi准将签署。
pairs.title_en: Exercise Hosting Coordination Framework in Qatar
pairs.title_zh: 卡塔尔演练主办协调框架

pairs.en: Congratulations to the Egyptian Search & Rescue Team EGY-01 for successfully passing the INSARAG External Classification (IEC) as a Medium team from 11 to 15 August 2026 in Egypt!
pairs.zh: 祝贺埃及搜救队 EGY-01 于 2026 年 8 月 11 日至 15 日在埃及成功通过 INSARAG 国际外部评估（IEC），获评中型救援队！
pairs.title_en: IEC EGY-01
pairs.title_zh: IEC EGY-01

pairs.en: This important achievement highlights the team’s strong operational capabilities, professionalism, and commitment to international search and rescue standards.
pairs.zh: 这一重要成就彰显了该队强大的行动能力、专业精神以及对国际搜救标准的承诺。
pairs.title_en: IEC EGY-01
pairs.title_zh: IEC EGY-01

pairs.en: The classification process, hosted in Egypt, demonstrated the team’s ability to operate effectively in complex emergency environments and to contribute to coordinated international response efforts.
pairs.zh: 此次在埃及主办的评估流程展示了该队在复杂紧急环境中有效开展行动并为协调一致的国际响应工作作出贡献的能力。
pairs.title_en: IEC EGY-01
pairs.title_zh: IEC EGY-01

pairs.en: This successful classification reflects Egypt’s continued dedication to strengthening global emergency response capacity.
pairs.zh: 此次成功通过评估体现了埃及对加强全球应急响应能力的持续投入。
pairs.title_en: IEC EGY-01
pairs.title_zh: IEC EGY-01

pairs.en: The INSARAG Secretariat extends its most sincere congratulations.
pairs.zh: INSARAG 秘书处致以最诚挚的祝贺。
pairs.title_en: IEC EGY-01
pairs.title_zh: IEC EGY-01

pairs.en: The Technisches Hilfswerk (THW) Schnell Einsatz Einheit Bergung Ausland (SEEBA) Team (GER-01) has been successfully reclassified from Heavy to Medium USAR team following the classification process conducted from 5 to 9 October 2026 in Austria.
pairs.zh: 德国技术援助署（THW）海外救援快速行动队（SEEBA）（GER-01）在2026年10月5日至9日于奥地利开展的分级评定流程后，已成功从重型USAR救援队重新分级为中型USAR救援队。
pairs.title_en: IEC GER-01
pairs.title_zh: IEC GER-01

pairs.en: The INSARAG Secretariat extends its sincerest congratulations.
pairs.zh: INSARAG秘书处致以最诚挚的祝贺。
pairs.title_en: IEC GER-01
pairs.title_zh: IEC GER-01

pairs.en: After several years of work, involving the entire French USAR community under the coordination of the French General Directorate for Civil Protection and Crisis Management/Office of Doctrine, Training and Equipment, the new national USAR doctrine was published in September 2021.
pairs.zh: 经过数年工作，在法国民防与危机管理总局/doctrine、培训与装备办公室的协调下，整个法国USAR界参与其中，新的国家USAR doctrine于2021年9月发布。
pairs.title_en: New national USAR doctrine and guidelines integrating INSARAG standards for responders in France
pairs.title_zh: 面向法国救援人员的、整合INSARAG标准的新国家USAR doctrine与指南

pairs.en: This doctrine is complemented by the national operational and technical guidelines for all French USAR responders: from first responders to regional, national and international teams.
pairs.zh: 该doctrine由国家行动与技术指南予以补充，适用于所有法国USAR救援人员：从第一响应者到地区、国家和国际救援队。
pairs.title_en: New national USAR doctrine and guidelines integrating INSARAG standards for responders in France
pairs.title_zh: 面向法国救援人员的、整合INSARAG标准的新国家USAR doctrine与指南

pairs.en: As France had committed to, in the context of the INSARAG recognition of its national accreditation process in July 2017, all INSARAG standards have been integrated into these new national guidelines which are now a reference for all USAR operations on the French territory (including overseas) and allowing, if necessary, a perfect coordination with possible international USAR teams requested to assist in France.
pairs.zh: 正如法国在2017年7月其国家认证流程获得INSARAG认可时所承诺的那样，所有INSARAG标准均已纳入这些新的国家指南，这些指南现已成为法国领土（包括海外）所有USAR行动的参考，并在必要时可与可能受邀援助法国的国际USAR救援队实现完美协调。
pairs.title_en: New national USAR doctrine and guidelines integrating INSARAG standards for responders in France
pairs.title_zh: 面向法国救援人员的、整合INSARAG标准的新国家USAR doctrine与指南
